column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# BuildNugets.sh packs in this order (dependency order - the Maui layer references the façade),
# the release and pull-request workflows generate their package tables from it, the package tests
# read it, and the device-test runner scripts clear the local NuGet cache for every id listed
# here. Adding a package means adding a row here and a project under src/ - nothing else keeps a
#   id      the NuGet package id, which is also the directory under src/ and the .csproj name
#   heads   reserved; the façade ships the full neutral+android+ios set and the Maui layer the
#           platform set, but nothing reads this column yet, so it stays -
#   deps    other ids in this repository it depends on, comma separated, or -
# The platform binding packages (MarketingCloudSDK.Net.Android, MarketingCloudSDK.Net.iOS) and
# the SFMCSDK.Net core umbrella are deliberately NOT rows: they are published from their own
# repositories and arrive as pinned PackageReferences - see Directory.Build.props.
